name: Quebradillas (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Quartered: red in the first and fourth quarters, and five wavy stripes of green and white in the second and third, after the shield.
history: Quebradillas is a town and municipality on the northern shore of Puerto Rico. The red stands for struggle, effort and sacrifice, and the wavy green and white stripes are taken from the shield.

features.role: wavy stripes of green and white in the second and third quarters
